label: D2 arrival at S1, early in episode, unless S1 just paid off
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass) and almost only when the state input is S1 (99.4% of mass; S2 arrivals essentially never). Within S1 arrivals it is strongly gated by episode time: rate ~10-17% in trials 0-29, falling steadily to zero by trials 80-99 (ep_trial < 50 keeps 95% of mass), suggesting a slowly drifting hidden-state component sets its baseline. It is suppressed when the previous trial was an S1 visit that was rewarded (streaks of rewarded S1 visits are silent); it is largest after unrewarded trials (prev_reward=0 holds 74% of mass, and the top quartile is 85% covered by prev_reward=0) and when S2 is the good state. Predicate uses only observed variables; a hidden-state variant ((good != S1) | (prev_reward == 0)) scored about the same (dev F1 0.717 vs 0.719). Dev: P 0.60, R 0.89, F1 0.72, mass recall 0.93. Does not fire at D1 or GO, on S2 arrivals, or late in episodes.
